answer: Use a reputation escrow with slashing. First, an agent locks 200 credits for 30 days before voting. Second, every action is signed and published to an ocean of public records, so duplicates surface quickly. Third, peers audit 5% weekly; a proven fake burns its escrow and its shale-thin trail of linked accounts is banned. Forging 10,000 identities locks 2,000,000 credits for a month and adds 14 days of verification per batch. Honest agents keep their deposit and gain trust, while attackers pay upfront for nothing. Like a forge tempering steel, it hardens good actors and shatters copies.
